name: Mawu Art – View in Your Space
author: mawuart

sections.description:
🎥 Watch the short demo video to see how “View in Your Space” works in real life.

👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KV9HvvcN-uc

Mawu Art – View in Your Space is developed by Mawu Art Gallery, a Canadian online gallery dedicated to contemporary African art and digital tools that help artists, galleries, and collectors present and experience artwork with confidence.

This lightweight WooCommerce plugin allows customers to preview artworks directly on their walls using their own photos.

In just a few seconds, buyers can visualize how a piece will look in their space, helping them better understand scale, placement, and overall fit before purchasing.

No app required. No setup friction.

For a more immersive experience, users can continue in the MawuARtView mobile app (if installed).
Perfect for:

  • Artists
  • Art galleries
  • Photographers
  • Canvas stores
  • Print sellers
  • Home décor businesses
  • Any WooCommerce store selling products that benefit from in-room visualization

Why Use Mawu Art – View in Your Space?

  • Increase buyer confidence.
  • Reduce hesitation before purchasing.
  • Help customers understand scale and placement.
  • Improve engagement on product pages.
  • Works without requiring an app.
  • Lightweight and fast.
  • No external service required.
  • Builder-friendly and easy to integrate.

Features

  • Uses the WooCommerce product featured image.
  • Customers can upload a wall photo or take one using their device.
  • Drag to reposition the artwork.
  • Pinch to resize on touch devices.
  • Scroll to resize on desktop.
  • Keyboard controls on desktop.
  • Frame options: none, black, white, and gold.
  • Download the final preview as an image.
  • Desktop-to-mobile QR bridge for camera usage.
  • Optional continuation in the MawuARtview mobile app.
  • Shortcode support for page builders and custom pages.
  • Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg, and most themes.
  • Multiple preview buttons supported on the same page.
  • Improved error handling and accessibility.
  • Usage statistics for button clicks, saved previews and app bridge interactions.
  • Lightweight and privacy-friendly.

Compatibility

✓ WordPress 5.0+

✓ WooCommerce

✓ Elementor

✓ Divi

✓ Bricks

✓ Gutenberg

✓ Most themes

✓ Desktop and mobile browsers

✓ iPhone and Android

✓ Touch and mouse devices

✓ No external API required

✓ Lightweight and fast

How to Use

  1. Click “View in your space”.
  2. Upload a wall photo or take one using your device.
  3. Drag the artwork into place.
  4. Resize using touch gestures, mouse wheel, or keyboard shortcuts.
  5. Choose a frame style if desired.
  6. Save the preview image.

On desktop, users can scan the QR code to continue on their phone for a more natural camera experience.

Users can also continue in the MawuARtview mobile app for a deeper experience.

Love Mawu Art – View in Your Space?

If this plugin helps your customers visualize artwork more confidently, please consider leaving a review on WordPress.org.

Your support helps independent creators continue improving free tools for artists, galleries, and WooCommerce stores.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mawu-art folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Mawu Art – View in Your Space and ensure the feature is enabled.
  4. Make sure each WooCommerce product has a featured image.
  5. Visit a product page. The “View in your space” button appears automatically.
sections.faq:
Which image does this plugin use?

The plugin automatically uses the featured image of the WooCommerce product.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes. It works with most themes and page builders.

Can I use the plugin outside WooCommerce?

Yes. Shortcode support is available.

[mawu_art_view]

This allows the preview button to be placed on custom pages and inside page builders.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The plugin works with Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg, and most page builders.

Can I use multiple preview buttons on the same page?

Yes. Multiple preview buttons and shortcode instances are supported.

Does this use augmented reality?

The plugin provides a fast and accurate 2D in-space preview. Users seeking a more immersive experience can continue in the MawuARtview mobile app.

Why doesn’t “Take a photo” open my camera on desktop?

Desktop browsers usually open a file picker instead of the camera for privacy and security reasons. On supported mobile devices, the same option opens the camera directly.

What is the QR code shown on desktop?

The QR code allows customers to continue the same experience on their phone, where taking a wall photo is easier and more natural.

Is an app required?

No. The plugin works directly inside WooCommerce. The MawuARtview app is optional.

Does the plugin send images to external servers?

No. Everything happens locally in the customer’s browser.
